block:
/v1/billing/credit-account:
    put:
      tags: [Billing]
      operationId: initializeBillingCreditAccount
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-bff
      x-kokoro-visibility: public
      x-kokoro-stability: beta
      x-kokoro-idempotency: inherent
      x-kokoro-permission: billing.self.write
      summary: Initialize only the admitted subject's zero Credit account
      description: Inherently idempotent. No query parameters; no recharge or grant. Unknown outcomes are checked through summary before an explicit retry.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { type: object, additionalProperties: false, maxProperties: 0 }
      responses:
        '200': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BillingSummarySuccess' }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BillingReadBadRequest' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BillingReadUnauthorized' }
        '403':
          description: Current subject forbidden or credit account disabled
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
        '429': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BillingReadRateLimited' }
        '502': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BillingReadBadGateway' }
        '503': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BillingReadUnavailable' }
